# polaris_namespaces (Data Source)

Lists the namespaces of a Polaris catalog: the top-level ones, or the direct children of `parent`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_namespaces" "under_sales" {
  catalog = "lakehouse"
  parent  = ["sales"]
}

# ["sales.eu", "sales.us", ...]
output "sales_namespaces" {
  value = [for ns in data.polaris_namespaces.under_sales.namespaces : join(".", ns)]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog.

### Optional

- `parent` (List of String) Namespace whose direct children are listed. Omit it to list the top-level namespaces.

### Read-Only

- `namespaces` (List of List of String) The namespaces, each as an ordered list of levels (full path, including `parent`), in the order returned by Polaris.
